colors.theme_strategy: Light & Airy Soft Pinks + Champagne Gold default, with Cozy Glow Dark Mode toggle

layout_and_spacing.viewport_target: Mobile First (390px iPhone width optimization), scaling cleanly to Tablet (768px) and Desktop (1440px)
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: px-4 sm:px-8 max-w-xl sm:max-w-2xl md:max-w-4xl lg:max-w-5xl mx-auto
layout_and_spacing.touch_targets: minimum 44px height and width for interactive buttons and cards

single_page_flow_sections.name: The Secret Gate
single_page_flow_sections.description: Lock screen preventing accidental views. Teasing subtitle, secret key input box with escalating cute hints for wrong attempts, and magical sparkle/confetti explosion upon unlock.
features: Escalating hint logic (Attempt 1: subtle hint, Attempt 2: specific memory hint, Attempt 3+: explicit clue)
Unlock button + Keyboard Enter key trigger
Confetti/Sparkle burst particle animation upon correct entry
Smooth page height expansion / gate slide out transition
data-testid='secret-gate-input', data-testid='secret-gate-submit', data-testid='secret-gate-hint'

single_page_flow_sections.name: Cinematic Hero & Counters
single_page_flow_sections.description: Gentle floating heart/star/petal canvas particles, animated Happy Birthday headline, live Days Together counter and Birthday Countdown timer.
features: Floating interactive particles (canvas or motion divs with subtle drift)
Days Together live counter (calculates exact days, hours, mins since anniversary date)
Birthday Countdown timer
Light / Dark mode floating quick toggle (top right fixed/glass)
data-testid='hero-headline', data-testid='days-together-counter', data-testid='birthday-countdown'

single_page_flow_sections.name: Our Story Vertical Timeline
single_page_flow_sections.description: 5-6 curated romantic milestones with subtle glowing vertical connector line, dates, captions, and lazy-loaded polaroid image frames fading in on scroll.
features: Vertical gold gradient timeline axis
Scroll-triggered fade and slide entrance (framer-motion initial/whileInView)
Polaroid frame styling with soft box shadow and light tilt effect
data-testid='timeline-item-0', data-testid='timeline-item-1', etc.

single_page_flow_sections.name: Memory Flip Cards (Centerpiece)
single_page_flow_sections.description: 2-column grid on mobile (responsive 2-4 on desktop). Cards flip UPWARDS 180 degrees around horizontal axis (rotateX) with true 3D perspective.
features: Front: Romantic title + decorative gold foil ribbon frame + subtle tilt-on-touch/hover
Back: High quality lazy-loaded photo on one side + handwritten note (Caveat font) beside/stacked with soft ambient shadow
3D perspective: perspective: 1000px, transform-style: preserve-3d, rotateX(180deg)
Works seamlessly with touch tap, mouse click, and keyboard Space/Enter
Haptic feedback triggers on flip if navigator.vibrate available
data-testid='memory-card-0', data-testid='memory-card-flip-btn-0'

single_page_flow_sections.name: The Letter & Finale
single_page_flow_sections.description: Heartfelt personal letter revealing line-by-line with soft opacity fade on scroll. Closing fireworks/floating lanterns finale scene with final sign-off.
features: Line-by-line scroll opacity reveal (Lenis + Framer Motion staggered view)
Hidden Heart Easter Egg: Small floating glowing heart that opens a modal secret message when tapped
Fireworks or Floating Lantern canvas animation trigger at the end of the letter
Replay unlock experience button
data-testid='letter-container', data-testid='easter-egg-heart', data-testid='finale-sign-off'

config_file_architecture.structure: Exported object containing: partnerName, secretWord, hintsArray, startDate, birthdayDate, timelineMoments, memoryCards, letterParagraphs, easterEggMessage.
config_file_architecture.purpose: Enables zero-code modification of all personal names, dates, photos, and messages.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using pure React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) components as per frontend setup.
Initialize Lenis smooth scrolling in App.js for cinematic weight and fluid scroll movement.
Ensure memory cards flip vertically (rotateX) on tap/click with framer-motion 3D perspective.
Ensure mobile layout handles 360px+ screens without any horizontal scroll bar.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all gate inputs, buttons, timeline items, memory cards, theme toggles, and easter egg triggers.
Implement canvas/framer-motion particle effects for floating petals in Hero and floating fireworks/lanterns in Finale.
